name: Madocsa (Hungary)
description: White field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Madocsa (a blue shield with a white church, a boat and a fish, with a helm, a crest and red, yellow and grey mantling) above the name MADOCSA in yellow.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Madocsa arms with helm, crest and mantling
